scope: N2 one-dimensional normal motion of the same design coupon. Reuse saved reference CSVs. No four-node/robot replay, old suite or GPU execution.
all_cases: Use both controls, all three nominal masses, all three original h and the entire original window. Enclose the whole scalar candidate path, do not treat a grid label as a solver pass.
quantities: within-step peak force and its time
step impulse J and mean force
time moment B=int(t_end-t)*force dt, impulse centroid and constant-held displacement error
per-step momentum, position/time-moment and energy defects
reference: Use the archived cumulative impulse, endpoint positions and velocities. Independently integrate the piecewise-linear interpolant to the fine force samples, inserting the known zero-force entry. For impact use the saved analytical peak in the owning step; bracket its time by sign of v-d*K*x*x/M in the fine samples. Other per-step peaks are fine samples. Treat centroids below the impulse resolution as unresolved.
candidate: Event-split, two-moment implicit step. Solve the two Bernstein velocity coefficients for a quadratic closing velocity; integrate to a cubic gap. Match the zeroth and first time moments of the compressive force law on this path. Use FP64 in the candidate. The observer reconstructs a cubic Hermite gap from actual piece endpoints and their represented velocities and encloses the constitutive force, even at a clipped rate factor. No reference trajectory enters the producer.
partition: Split true free entry ballistically; in an active span use n=ceil(8*duration*max(K*d*delta/M,sqrt(K*(1+d*rate_max)/M))), at least one piece. This a priori rate bound uses nominal material and the declared speed domain. Do not refine to fit an observed answer. Outer h stays unchanged; all inner stages are charged.
interpretation: Imported trace tolerances are scalar comparison gates only. Match actual path force moments, nonnegative law and whole-path hard core. Include any negative instantaneous force inferred solely from the reconstructed acceleration as a separate strict-sign finding: such a path cannot certify pointwise non-tensile delivery, even if integrated observables pass. No numerical forces are fed back from the oracle. A failure retains its first step and full admitted evidence; do not retune the coupon, tolerances, rates or limits.
